translit: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn, wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihī wa ṣaḥbihī ajmaʿīn. Wa baʿd.

text: Last week, we left off talking about the story of the [[Quraysh|قريش]] and how they re-controlled or regained control of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]],
and how from the lineage of [[Qusayy ibn Kilab|قُصَيّ بن كِلَاب]] came the grandfather of the Prophet ﷺ,
whose name was actually [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]], but he became well-known as [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], and [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] is the name that stuck with him.
So he came back into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] when he reached the age of adolescence,
and eventually the responsibilities of taking care of the [[hujjaj|حجاج]] in terms of providing them with drink, it came to [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]].
Because [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] was from the lineage of [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]],

and [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]] was the son of [[Qusayy ibn Kilab|قُصَيّ بن كِلَاب]] who was given the responsibility of providing drink for the [[hujjaj|حجاج]], providing water for the [[hujjaj|حجاج]].
And it went on to the sons of [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]], and then to their sons,
and it went eventually to [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] who was the grandfather of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
Now, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], his first son was named al-Harith.
This was the first son of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]. Later on, he had many more sons, he had a total of 10 sons, but his firstborn son was al-Harith.
Now, when al-Harith grew to an age of adolescence, when he became a strong young man,
[[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] saw a dream. He saw a dream.
And in this dream, a voice came to him in the dream and said to him,
And then [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] asked,
"What is Ṭībah?" And there was no answer, and the voice went away.
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] thought about this dream, and he wondered what it meant.
The next night, the voice came to him again in his dream.
And this time, the voice said to him,
And then [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] asked the voice,
"What is Barrah?" And there was no answer from the voice, and the voice went away.
The third night, again he had a dream, a voice saying to him,
And then [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] asked the voice,
"What is al-Maḍmūnah?" And there was no answer from the voice, and the voice went away. So this went on for three nights.
The fourth night,
the fourth night he had a dream again with the voice saying to him,
And then [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] asked,
"What is [[Zamzam|زمزم]]?"
And then the voice said to him in the dream,

translit: Lā tanzifu abadan wa lā tarum, tasqil-ḥajjājal-aʿẓam, wa hiya baynar-rafthi wad-dam, ʿinda naqratil-ghurābil-aʿṣam, ʿinda qaryatin-naml.

text: So they explained, the voice explained to [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] where he could find
the [[Zamzam|زمزم]] with these few lines.
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] remembered the words that he heard in this dream.
Now, the caller in the dream didn't tell him the exact location where the [[Zamzam|زمزم]] was, but
some signs were given. Some signs were given, and those signs were three signs.
The [[Zamzam|زمزم]], you will find it between ar-rafth and ad-dam. Ar-rafth is used to describe
the intestines of an animal. The intestines of an animal is called ar-rafth. And ad-dam is blood.
So this is the first clue that was given to [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] in the dream about the location of [[Zamzam|زمزم]]. It is between the intestines of the animal and the blood.
Okay, you might think this is strange. Where are you going to find intestines of an animal and blood, you know, in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] near the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]?
So that was the first sign. The second sign was
In the place where al-ghurāb al-aʿṣam... And al-ghurāb al-aʿṣam is a crow, and you know what color is a crow, a crow is black.
So al-ghurāb, it means a crow, and a crow is known to be black. But al-ghurāb al-aʿṣam,
this is what the Arabs used to call a crow that was black, but it had a white feather in the wing.
A crow is usually completely black, but if you find a crow that's all black, but there's one white feather in the wing,
this is what the Arabs used to call al-ghurāb al-aʿṣam, the crow with a white feather in the wing.
So this is the second clue. Where the crow with the white feather in its wing pecks,
So it is between the intestines of the animal and the blood, it is in a place where the crow with whiteness in its wing pecks.
At the ant colony, where the ants have made a village, or where the ants have made a colony.
So these were the three signs that were given to [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] in the dream as where to find [[Zamzam|زمزم]].
Now, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] and the people who lived in his time, they had never seen [[Zamzam|زمزم]] before, but they knew what [[Zamzam|زمزم]] was.
Because they knew the story of [[Zamzam|زمزم]]. They knew that their forefathers had settled in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] because of [[Zamzam|زمزم]].
And they knew that when the tribe of [[Khuza'ah|خزاعة]] overtook the tribe of [[Jurhum|جرهم]] in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]],
before [[Jurhum|جرهم]] was overtaken, they buried that well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]] so that [[Khuza'ah|خزاعة]] could not benefit from it.

So they knew about this story. They knew that [[Zamzam|زمزم]] existed, and they knew the story of [[Zamzam|زمزم]], and they knew the story of why the well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]] was buried by their forefathers.
But why didn't they go around looking for it? Even though they knew it existed, why didn't they go around looking for it? Because they didn't know where to look for it.

They knew it was there somewhere in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], but you think they're going to go digging around all of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] looking for that well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]]? No, of course they can't do that.
But now [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] in this dream, the location was narrowed down to him by these three clues.
So he thought, "Okay, maybe I have a chance. Maybe I can actually narrow it down, and I can finally find the well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]] again." And what a great honor that would be!
What a great honor that would be. So he decided to try to follow the clues that he saw in his dream.
And he took his son with him, al-Harith. And al-Harith was the only one of his sons at that time who had reached an age of strength. He was a young man,
and he could actually help his father out. As for the other children, they were still little.
You know, he didn't have anyone else who could really go with him and work with him. So he took his son al-Harith,
and he went there to the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. And he was thinking about the first sign:
It is between the intestines of the animal and the blood. So he was thinking, "Where am I going to find this?"
And at that point, somebody or a group of people had come to the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]],
and we know that at this time the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] had idols inside it, the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] had idols around it.
And two of those idols that were near the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] were [[Isaf|إساف]] and [[Na'ilah|نائلة]], and we spoke about them in a previous lesson.
[[Isaf|إساف]] and [[Na'ilah|نائلة]], they were those two people, the boy and the girl who had come from [[Yemen|اليمن]],
and they were doing immoral actions in the [[Haram|حرم]] itself, and Allah Almighty caused them to turn into stone.
And when [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لحي]] brought idol worship back into the [[Jazirat al-Arab|بفرة العرب]],

he took these two stones of [[Isaf|إساف]] and [[Na'ilah|نائلة]] and put them in front of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]]. So people would go there and they would actually offer sacrifices there, and they would worship those stones.
So this continued until the time of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], it was still going on, people were still worshipping the idols.
So when [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] came with his son to start his search for the lost well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]],
a group of people came to the idol of [[Isaf|إساف]] with a cow.
And they were going to sacrifice that cow to [[Isaf|إساف]], to the idol. They were going to slaughter that cow as a sacrifice to this idol.
So they started sacrificing the cow, they started cutting it, slaughtering it. So they cut the neck, and the blood started pouring out of the neck. So the blood was all over the ground there.

But the cow, it was a bit strong, so it was able to get loose even though it was bleeding and it was hurt. It was able to get loose, and it jumped up and it started running with blood dripping all from it.
But of course, you know, it was weakened because of the blood loss. So eventually a little bit as it ran, you know, maybe for some time, then it fell down again.
And then they caught it again, and they were able to overpower it, and they completed cutting it. And they cut open the stomach as well.
